messages:
Jules (CSM): Quick dump from two onboarding calls this morning with fintech pilots (BlueHarbor & PayLoom). Dropping raw quotes so we can triage.
Priya (PM): thanks — can you bullet the asks?
Jules (CSM): 1) tenant-scoped/pinned prompt library (audit export + RBAC so devs can't change prod prompts) 2) human-readable changelog/diff when model variants or prompt sets change 3) much faster tiny-update embedding refresh (<30s target) — both customers hit ~80-120s today
Eli (ProdOps): tenant-scoped prompts implies separate storage + permission checks. export for audits = CSV/JSON dump feature.
Nora (Support): we already have a ticket (SUP-4542) asking for a "what changed" view for model updates. Legal teams ask for exports during procurement.
Jules (CSM): verbatim from BlueHarbor: "Our compliance team needs to lock the approved prompts and get a nightly export for audits." PayLoom: "When our embeddings don't update fast, our workflows replay wrong answers. We need <30s for small sets."
Priya (PM): impact rating from your calls, quick H/M/L?
Jules (CSM): tenant prompts = HIGH (procurement blocker). changelog/diffs = MED (reduces trust/regression anxiety). embedding refresh <30s = MED (automation reliability + onboarding).
Eli (ProdOps): quick mitigation idea: add a /v1/embeds/refresh endpoint that accepts a small batch and forces an immediate upsert to the vector store. Low-effort shim while we design streaming ingestion.
Priya (PM): good. UX question: do customers want an audit CSV only or a UI export and retention policy?
Jules (CSM): both. BlueHarbor wants scheduled exports (S3 drop) + UI to review pinned prompts.
Nora (Support): I'll attach SUP-4542 and draft KB steps for the refresh endpoint. Sample curl in KB helps support-runbooks.
Priya (PM): Eli, ballpark S/M/L for: a) tenant-pinned prompts + RBAC + export, b) refresh endpoint shim, c) changelog diffs UI/backend?
Eli (ProdOps): a) Medium (DB + api + UI + permission matrix). b) Small (shim + docs). c) Small-Medium (frontend work + snapshot diffing backend).
Jules (CSM): note: PayLoom said they'd fund a short pilot to get the <30s behavior. Adding to triage as paid-pilot interest.
handoff-bot: Triage card created by Jules (CSM) 13 https://notion.redwood/inbox/field-voice-1733339999 assigned to Priya (PM).
Priya (PM): next steps: - Jules paste verbatim quotes + account contacts into triage card - Eli drop a short tech note with ballpark estimates - Nora link support ticket and draft KB - I'll review at prioritization sync and propose workaround path if any estimate >2w
Jules (CSM): done — quotes + contacts added. BlueHarbor contact: leah@blueharbor.com. PayLoom contact: ops@payloom.io.
Eli (ProdOps): tech note posted on triage card with tradeoffs and the push-refresh API prototype idea.
Nora (Support): KB draft added (curl + curl --data examples) and linked to SUP-4542.
Priya (PM): thanks all. If engineering confirms >2w for a robust solution, we'll offer the push-refresh shim + exportable prompt JSON and propose a paid pilot to PayLoom.
Jules (CSM): closing loop from my side. react on the triage card if you need more raw transcript. :thumbsup:
